Overview of Canton of Zurich Region (Zürich)

Canton of Zurich Region (Zürich) is located in the Canton of Zurich region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Zurich. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Zürich Altstadt & Limmatquai, Lake Zurich cruises & Uetliberg, Kunsthaus Zürich & Landesmuseum, Winterthur museums & Rhine Falls gateway.

RegionCanton of Zurich
Capital cityZurich
Cities & municipalities96
Primary transport hubZurich Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Canton of Zurich Region

Zurich Airport (ZRH) has a mainline SBB railway station underneath the terminal (10 min to Zürich HB). Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Canton of Zurich

When visiting cities across Canton of Zurich, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Zürcher Geschnetzeltes with Rösti
  • Luxemburgerli macarons
  • Fondue in historic guild houses
  • Craft chocolate

Best time to visit Canton of Zurich

Best time to visit Canton of Zurich: May–Sep, Dec (Christmas markets).
